ARCS kitMolecule 47now-note

Now Note

Tell the reader, in one sentence at the top, what to do now, and let them dismiss it once read; a changed note comes back.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1BoxBordered row, pill left, sentence, X rightsurface, border, ds-r-md
2PillDot plus Now, caps, 0.75em; hidden from screen readers (a hidden Now: prefix reads instead)green on green-bg
3SentenceBold lead clause then the action; one sentencetext
4Dismiss44px X, SVG, top-righttext-secondary, hover text on cyan-bg
5MemorylocalStorage key = prefix plus a hash of the note text, wrapped in try/catchnone

Usage

Use it when

  • Above the fold, to lead with the reader's next action (Start with the agreement...), not a link back to a tab they already saw.
  • The note changes as the work moves; hashing the text means each new note shows once even if an older one was dismissed.

Do not use it when

  • Do not stack more than one note, or use it for status figures (the status strip holds those).
  • Do not rely on dismissal for anything important: storage can be blocked, and then the note simply stays.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
leadstringyesThe bold clause, such as Step 1, which you said yes to on November 6.
textstringyesThe action that follows the lead.
keystringyesStorage prefix for the page family, such as myAllyNow; the hash is appended.
focusAfterselectornoWhere focus goes after dismissal (the next control), so it is never lost to the body.

Access

  • role=note; the pill is aria-hidden and a visually hidden Now: prefix carries its meaning.
  • The X is a <button> named Dismiss note, 44px square, with a 2px cyan focus ring.
  • After dismissal focus moves to a named next control.
  • Storage reads and writes sit in try/catch; with storage blocked the note just stays visible.
